arms.Z: bonds from vl.py round 0 (Learner.round0, kernels pass_count / pass_synneff imported read-only from $RD/vocab_lists/code/vl.py) with ws_calib z >= 10.6 lists (vl.z_lists over $RD/calib/table, one best match per genome, own group excluded), group counting (vl 'grp': n = 1 + supporting groups, E over groups, Lambda >= tau, n >= 2), round-0 homolog exclusion mask $RD/vocab_lists/excl/group_order{-1,0,1,2}.npz (K1000), tau = stored tau* 6 (vocab_lists job_z.json)

arms.Zs: z10.6 lists with own GENOME excluded (vl convention for the synteny unit), excl genome masks, vl 'syn' counting (Lambda over genomes x N_eff / n, N_eff from the synteny-retention matrix of this list set and order, <= 64 carriers, N_eff >= 2); tau* from vl's rule (round-0 instance FDR over 3 gene-order shuffles <= 0.01, ladder 4-20) computed here
arms.As: aln lists, own genome excluded, syn counting, tau* computed here as for Zs

arms.FZ: EXPLORATORY: boundary bonded when the family bond (F, tau 10) or the Z bond (tau 6) spans it; s_k = max of the two Lambdas; tree and filter as the list arms (Z lists)

reproduction_gate: the observed and shuffled round-0 ladder counts of Z and A must equal the stored counts in job_z.json / job_aln.json exactly before any locus is built from them
outputs_per_arm: L1 (runs of bonded boundaries), L4b(theta) and L4b+(theta) with part-1 tree code unchanged (ll.build_tree / tree / boundary_score), theta in {0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2}
cohesion: list arms and FZ: kappa_var_knn50.npy (context_units, kNN homologs, family-free) primary; the same outputs with kappa_var_tokens.npy reported as a check for the selected theta. F: tokens (as part 1)

family_free_node_filter.definition: identity of a node gene = its list partners. For node I: genes of I with a non-empty list = |I|; q = max(2, ceil(0.5 |I|)); W = 2 |I|; a genome holds I when a window of <= W consecutive genes on one contig contains list partners of >= q distinct genes of I (each partner position counted for one node gene only, the lowest-indexed one listing it). n = groups other than the node's own with such a genome; E = closed form of part 1 with c_f(g) = list partners of node gene f in genome g; kept if n >= 2 and Lambda(n, E) >= the arm's bond tau. For the syn arms the node test counts groups (as part 1).
family_free_node_filter.why: the family test asks whether half of the node's families recur together; with no families, a node gene's identity is the set of genes that list it, which is the same object the bonds are made of

selection_odd: per arm, among L1 / L4b(theta) / L4b+(theta) with the arm's primary kappa (9 candidates): maximise [odd conditions met vs DH (vscore.odd_conditions), odd ribosomal resolved, odd summed] (part-1 rule, amendment_1). Written to predeclared2.json (amendment) before any even number.
even_report: per arm, the selected output: the seven quantities; paired intervals (genome bootstrap 2,000 draws, seed 17) against token DH, against part-1 L4b theta .1, and Z against A (selected outputs); ribosomal resolved paired vs DH and vs part-1 L4b; boundary precision; share of genes in loci; CRISPR-Cas member genes (instances >= 2 members) outside every locus; for the 56 runs that part-1 L4b leaves under-covered: how many have every internal boundary bonded in the arm, and how many each arm resolves; wall time and peak memory. Token-kappa check of the selected output; FZ exploratory.

expectations.reproduction: Z and A ladders equal the stored counts
expectations.Z: L1 over-extends (resolved 800-1,100); selected L4b or L4b+: resolved 1,500-1,620, recovered >= 1,675, Parv 114, CCT F1 .45-.50, DF .76-.81, TXSS .64-.70, summed .50-.58
expectations.A: within .02 summed and .015 CCT F1 of Z; resolved within 60 of Z
expectations.Zs_As: CCT F1 +.02 to +.04 above Z / A, summed within -.03 of them
expectations.FZ: between F and Z on CCT; resolved 1,560-1,620
expectations.all_bars: probability about one half that one output (most likely Zs or As L4b / L4b+) meets all seven bars; CRISPR-Cas F1 is the bar most likely to remain short, then summed excess (list bonds lengthen loci and raise the control)
expectations.under_covered_56: list bonds bond every internal boundary of 25-50 of the 56 runs, and the selected list outputs resolve 15-40 of them
expectations.cas_outside: CRISPR-Cas member genes outside every locus: F L4b 30-40%, list arms 15-28%
